feedback_intervention_trigger.executed_only_if: the trigger below fires on its registered readouts
feedback_intervention_trigger.seed_and_state: 60% seed1001 only; evaluated once per pair after both units have their E10_RECORD (completed 10); list pair first
feedback_intervention_trigger.trigger: A and B and C (all three)
feedback_intervention_trigger.A_one_step_favorable: on the common H parent wp_f60_s1001_H_e5, a fixed diagnostic list of 64 FIT labeled batches (selected once from the parent with a fixed seed, ids/hash registered before evaluation, disjoint from the 64 calibration batches); group correct-hard = observed pair correct (offline evaluator) and the observed positive not ranked first by the parent; layer C one-step probe (main + native intra/noisy terms, real clipping and the inherited AdamW, one step from an isolated copy): mean delta(observed margin) of the VCS objective >= the control objective and > 0, with >= 100 correct-hard comparisons
feedback_intervention_trigger.B_natural_continuation_worse: E10 full-DEV rSum (same parent, same seed, fixed completed epoch 10) of the VCS unit <= control unit - 2.0
feedback_intervention_trigger.C_feedback_divergence: at any completed epoch 1..10, for either peer: relative difference of the GMM clean-split size n_pred_clean >= 0.10, or absolute difference of the noisy-branch usable-candidate fraction (i2t or t2i, epoch mean) >= 0.05, or absolute difference of the split precision (offline evaluator only) >= 0.05

intervention.design: 2x2: {VCS objective, matched control objective} x {native dynamic feedback, common reference feedback}
intervention.common_start: the control unit's immutable completed-10 checkpoint (state_completed10.pt), copied for every cell; the VCS cell switches only the main objective (registered coefficient for PV)
intervention.window: co-train epoch raw 10: native prelude (adjust_learning_rate, GMM split from the common state) then exactly 200 training iterations per peer (A then B, native order); identical budget in all four cells; each peer's actual optimizer.step count recorded
intervention.native_dynamic_feedback: each cell generates its own split (identical at the window start), queue writes, other-peer candidate identities and detached candidate re-encodings / refiner targets
intervention.common_reference_feedback: replay, from the control cell under native feedback in the same window: GMM split + reliability probabilities + avg_clean_prob, labeled / unlabeled batch ids in order, queue contents and IDs written, noisy-branch candidate identities (cols / inv / A) and their detached re-encoded embeddings; each cell still encodes its own inputs with its own encoder and refiner
intervention.readouts: full-DEV rSum + six recalls after the window, main/intra/noisy gradient norms, split stats, fixed-list margins when available
intervention.claims: answers only whether the VCS-control gap changes under this artificial fixed-feedback intervention; not a causal mediation decomposition of natural training; fixed feedback is not a candidate method

feedback_intervention_trigger.budget: 4 cells x 200 iterations x 2 peers per triggered pair (~0.3 GPUh), not part of the 1080 epoch units
